newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore woman and son arrested over maid beating.
newsitem.headline: Singapore woman and son arrested over maid beating.

text.p: Singapore police said on Thursday they had arrested a 38-year-old housewife and her son of 13 for physically abusing their Indonesian maid.
"Yes, they have been arrested. The charge is voluntarily causing grievous hurt," a police spokesman told Reuters.
The names of the two were not disclosed and would not be released until a court hearing of the case against them, the date of which was yet to be confirmed, the spokesman said.

The charges were brought after the maid was admitted to hospital with injuries including swollen legs caused by repeated scalding and various bruises, welts and scars, the Straits Times newspaper said.

The maid, who said she was 15 years old -- a year younger than the minimum of 16 for foreign domestic servants in Singapore -- not the 19 stated in her passport, told the paper she was beaten constantly after starting work three months ago.
The Ministry of Labour told Reuters it was looking into the case to establish how an apparently underage maid had been employed.
The Ministry said it had barred the maid's employers from engaging other staff until the police investigation was completed.
An employer convicted of abuse could be permanently barred from hiring another foreign maid in addition to a possible jail term.
